# orbivisor_router (Resource)

An SDN router: interfaces on SDN networks, an external gateway and static routes.

Manifest kind `Router`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `external` (Dynamic) External gateway (provider network, SNAT).
- `folder` (String) Folder path (`/prod/web`); empty is the tree's root. Changing it replaces the object (move it with `orbivisorctl folder move` and change the path here instead).
- `interfaces` (Dynamic) Interfaces: list of `{ network = "name", … }`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `routes` (Dynamic) Static routes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
